summary: Iteration 6 — hotel branding plumbed end-to-end. 8/8 backend tests pass; full UI flow validated. /api/auth/me + /api/guest/me return hotel.logo_url/brand_color/default_language; /api/push/subscribe with Bearer persists user_id (verified via direct Mongo read) and /auth/delete-account clears push_subs; legacy /guest/login + push/subscribe + push/test still respond 200; /stays/join still delivers welcome coupon. Frontend: hotel-logo testid renders with correct src, header border-bottom-color and hotel name color set to #0EA5E9 inline, service worker is registered with active controller, push-denied + pwa-unavailable fallback testids render correctly in headless mode. Admin demo state restored at end (brand_color=null, logo_url=null, admin_password=admin123, welcome_coupon_template_id unchanged).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 1662 lines — past the 700-line guideline. Still recommend splitting into modules (auth, stays, admin, coupons, messages, push, branding). Carried over from iter-5.
POST /api/admin/change-password still compares hotel.admin_password in PLAIN TEXT. Carried over from iter-5.

/api/push/subscribe relies on get_current_guest, which means a Bearer-token user MUST have an active stay or it will 403. This is correct for production flow (you only subscribe inside the app) but worth keeping in mind: subscribing before joining a hotel will fail.
Branding lives on the hotel doc only — there is no per-user/per-stay override. For multi-hotel users this means colour/logo flip on each /auth/me. Currently fine for the MVP.

GuestApp.jsx applies brand_color as inline style and via document.documentElement CSS var — the cleanup useEffect removes the var on unmount, but the meta[name='theme-color'] is never reset to the default if the user switches hotels with no brand colour. Minor UX nit.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (hotel-logo + brand_color + service worker + push-denied + pwa-unavailable all verified)

test_credentials: Admin: access_code=WELCOME2026, password=admin123 (verified restored at end). Test users registered ad-hoc as vis_<ts>@chathel.test / abc12345; one was soft-deleted by the push+soft-delete test, others remain joined but harmless.
seed_data_creation: None permanent. The welcome-coupon regression test creates a TEST_WC_iter6 coupon template, sets it as welcome template, joins, then restores the previous welcome_coupon_template_id and deletes the template in finally{}.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run with: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=https://hotel-gather.preview.emergentagent.com MONGO_URL=mongodb://localhost:27017 DB_NAME=test_database pytest /app/backend/tests/test_iteration6.py -v. The test session autouse fixture PATCHes hotel branding (brand_color=#0EA5E9, logo_url=https://placehold.co/...) and restores it to empty at session teardown — do not assert on branding being null mid-run. Direct Mongo (pymongo) is used to verify push_subs persistence. /api/admin/me returns {hotel:{...}} wrapper; PATCH /api/admin/hotel returns the flat hotel dict. brand_color validation requires '#' prefix or empty string. /api/push/subscribe requires either X-Guest-Token (legacy) OR Bearer token + active stay (new flow). UI: hotel-logo and brand color verified at /app; push-denied + pwa-unavailable verified at /app/settings (these are the only testids visible in headless mode).
rca of the issue: N/A — no defects found in this iteration.
